newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BOAVISTA SMASH SEVEN BUT SPORTING WIN AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOAVISTA SMASH SEVEN BUT SPORTING WIN AGAIN.

text.p: Mid-table Boavista produced the Portuguese first division's goal-scoring performance of the season when they crushed bottom-placed Gil Vicente 7-0 at home on Sunday.

Hat-tricks from Jerrel Jimmy and Nuno Gomes and an own goal by Gil Vicente's Joao Tuck set the new record, previously held by champions Porto who had beaten both Braga and Espinho 5-0 earlier in the season.
Closer to the top of the table, second-placed Sporting recovered after going 1-0 down to beat Setubal 2-1 at home.

Veteran Nigerian striker Rashid Yekini put Setubal ahead in the 20th minute but Afonso Martins equalised seven minutes later and midfielder Jose Vidigal gave his team their winner five minutes from time.
Sporting are in second place with 62 points, eight behind Porto, while Benfica trail third with 54.

Porto continued their steady progress towards a third successive title with a 2-0 win over Maritimo on Friday, the goals coming in the space of three minutes in the second half from Slovenian midfielder Zlatko Zahovic and Artur Oliveira.

Benfica came from behind to beat Farense 2-1 in their away match on Saturday. A ninth minute goal from Yugoslav Dragam Punisic was matched by newly-signed Brazilian striker Valdir Moraes in the 22nd minute. Winger Edgar Pacheco secured the points with the decisive strike 14 minutes from the end.
